svg.title: Spectral matrices, an owned image shard and calibrated pyramid levels
svg.desc: Schematic acquired-band planes share one bounded spatial window. Its pixels form columns of a B by P raw matrix. Per-band offset, intensity-correction divisor and response multiplier produce Y. The B by C reference S and Y feed the selected NNLS or clipped least-squares solver. The C by P coefficients receive reporting weights once, reshape to component planes and fill an owned all-channel shard. At most two tasks repeat this block loop. Complete full-resolution output supplies spatial two-by-two pyramid reduction; channel count stays C and recorded spatial scales double. Separated component images instead copy their supplied pyramid without fitting or changing scalar values. Plane patterns and matrix entries are schematic.
svg.text: Place each block in its owned shard
